name: Dragonmeet
blurb: A one-day tabletop gaming convention at London's ExCeL with RPGs, board games, organised play and a large trade hall.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'DRAGONMEET LONDON EXCEL SATURDAY 28TH NOVEMBER 2026 SHOW OPENING TIMES 09:00 - 22:00'; meta description: 'Dragonmeet RPG convention which takes place on Saturday 28th November 2026 at London Excel'.

notes: A trade/hobbyist tabletop gaming show (RPGs, board games, organised play, 200+ exhibitors) with no celebrity guest programme; the full site navigation (tickets, live events, gaming, awards, exhibitors, policies) has no guests or guest-of-honour page anywhere, so guests is 'none'.
